title: A single loop method for quadratic minmax optimization
summary: We consider a quadratic minmax problem with coupled inner constraints and propose a method to compute a class of stationary points. To motivate the need to compute such stationary points, we first show that they are meaningful, in the sense that they can be locally optimal for our problem under suitable{non-degeneracy} conditions.
